prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 26 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1179; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. Initial evaluation revealed a closed distal radius fracture of the right wrist with associated swelling and limited range of motion. Imaging confirmed the fracture pattern, and the wrist was immobilized in a splint pending further assessment.

Over the course of treatment, the patient completed 26 visits. Care included orthopedic follow-up, serial radiographs to monitor alignment and healing, and a structured physical therapy program focused on restoring grip strength, wrist flexion and extension, and forearm rotation. Pain was managed with a combination of over-the-counter and prescribed analgesics, with gradual reduction in reported pain levels as therapy progressed.

At the most recent evaluation, radiographs demonstrated satisfactory healing. The patient has regained most functional range of motion, though some residual grip weakness and intermittent stiffness with prolonged activity remain. Continued home exercise is recommended, with a plan for reassessment should symptoms worsen or fail to improve.
